root_cause.text: The `qd_put()` function freed quota data objects without first removing them from the global LRU list, leaving stale entries that the shrinker (`gfs2_qd_shrink_scan`) could later access after the object was freed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `list_lru_del_obj(&gfs2_qd_lru, &qd->qd_lru)` before `gfs2_qd_dispose(qd)` in the code path that frees the quota data object when its reference count reaches zero. The commit message explicitly states that the prior change (a475c5dd16e5) failed to remove these objects from the LRU list, causing use-after-free when the shrinker accessed freed objects.

intent_record.what: Added a call to list_lru_del_obj to remove the quota data object from the global LRU list before disposing it.
intent_record.how: The change ensures that when a quota data object is being disposed after its lockref is marked dead, it is first removed from the global LRU list (gfs2_qd_lru) to prevent the LRU from later referencing freed memory.
